Dermatologically Tested
settings.description: Safety first with Little Étoile® Care - SwimProtect 2-In-1 has been dermatologically tested and is safe for sensitive skin.

settings.heading: Tears-Be-Gone
settings.description:
Little Étoile® Care SwimProtect 2-In-1 was found to be safe for sensitive skin in a study performed by an accredited dermatology clinic on 54 Australian subjects. It showed no signs of skin irritation (dermatologist’s score of 0/4) on upper arm skin after 24 hrs of exposure.
Reference
Ozderm Pty Ltd. 20231009, protocol MBC012 pp1-20.

settings.heading: Clinical report on skin safety
settings.description:
Little Étoile® Care SwimProtect 2-In-1 was found to be safe for sensitive skin in a study performed by an accredited dermatology clinic on 54 Australian subjects. It showed no signs of skin irritation (dermatologist’s score of 0/4) on upper arm skin after 24 hrs of exposure.
Reference
Ozderm Pty Ltd. 20231009, protocol MBC012 pp1-20.

settings.heading: Clinical Lab Report for eye safety
settings.description:
In a clinical laboratory study conducted by an OECD accredited testing facility in Europe, Little Étoile® Care SwimProtect 2-In-1 was shown to be safe for human eyes, measured to be within the acceptable range (average of 2.8/80 on a damage scale).
Reference
Eurofins Dermatest. IR02p146(1-4), 20230904.
